description: Add tests for thunder module (models, sources, monitor) - 219 lines at 0% coverage. Tests FeedItem creation, RSSSource/WebhookSource polling, ThunderMonitor deduplication and lifecycle.
steps: Test FeedItem model: auto-generated id from URL hash, from_rss_entry class method with various entry dicts (with/without link, with/without title, with/without published_parsed)
Test SourceConfig model: defaults, validation (priority 1-10, poll_interval >= 1)
Test WebhookSource: start/stop are no-ops, receive() adds items, poll() drains internal queue and returns items, poll() returns empty list when no items

Test RSSSource: mock httpx to simulate RSS feed response, test poll() parses feedparser output into FeedItem list, test conditional request headers (ETag, If-Modified-Since), test 304 Not Modified returns empty list, test network error returns empty list gracefully
Test ThunderMonitor._deduplicate: filters already-seen URLs, respects _MAX_SEEN_URLS eviction, adds new URLs to seen set
Test ThunderMonitor lifecycle: start() creates tasks for each source, stop() cancels tasks and stops sources, stats property returns correct counts
Test ThunderMonitor._poll_source with mocked source: items are put into output_queue, deduplication prevents duplicates
findings: All 48 tests pass. Coverage: models.py 100%, sources.py 98%, monitor.py 93%, overall 96%. pytest-asyncio auto mode works well with async def test methods in classes.
